name: TC060_edge_aanvrager_oranje_outranks_partner_oranje

name: TC061_gap_aanvrager_rood_partner_groen
description: RECORDED MODEL GAP, not a defect in this pass. R5 needs BOTH people rood and R16 needs BOTH groen, so one rood and one groen matches nothing: RechtOpALO returns no row, and Beslissing ALO therefore returns an empty result set. The source model has the same hole. Flagged for Den Haag rather than closed on inference about how a mixed household should be decided.

name: TC062_gap_partner_rood_aanvrager_groen
description: The mirror image of the case above, included so the gap is documented as symmetric rather than looking like an aanvrager-only problem.
